items.headline: World Leaders Gather in New York for the 81st UN General Assembly Opening
items.summary: The 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly high-level debate opened in New York on September 22, 2026, bringing world leaders together to address international security and global cooperation. U.S. President Donald Trump delivered a prominent address focusing on foreign policy and international conflicts, making the opening session a main driver of global news today.

items.headline: At the UN, Trump Rejects International AI Oversight and Orders Rebrand to 'Super Intelligence'
items.summary: Addressing the United Nations General Assembly, U.S. President Donald Trump firmly rejected proposals for international governance of artificial intelligence, calling global regulatory efforts an unnecessary restriction on innovation. During the speech, he also announced an executive directive ordering all U.S. federal agencies to replace the term 'artificial intelligence' with 'super intelligence' in official communications.

items.headline: Manchester City Mounts Two-Goal Comeback Against Bayern Munich in Women's Champions League Opener
items.summary: Manchester City rallied from two goals down on Tuesday to secure a dramatic 2-2 draw against Bayern Munich on the opening night of the UEFA Women's Champions League phase. The thrilling match highlighted the start of Matchday 1 as Europe's premier women's club competition kicked off its new season under an 18-team league format.
